headline: Approved handbook updates, a building access policy, and a medication policy; sent purchasing policy DJ to the full committee for a first read.
summary: Concern about Zoom recording meetings by default led Steven Mogul to commit to following up with the technology team. A 2-1 vote changed how payment warrants are approved under Policy DK. Staff also said a new procedure will likely be needed to carry out the medication policy.
decisions: Approved the HPS Staff Handbook Update unanimously.
Approved the HPS Family Handbook Update on page 48 (Protect Act and Code of Conduct) unanimously.
Approved the meeting minutes of 8.26.26 and 9.23.26 unanimously.
Sent Policy DJ-Purchasing to the full school committee for a first read, unanimously.
Approved changing Policy DK so the committee designates one member by vote to approve warrants, 2-1.
Approved Policy ECAB, Access to Building and Grounds, unanimously.
Approved Policy JLCDC, Self-Administration and Self-Carry of Medications, unanimously.
